paragraphs: Rav Sheshet of Kartiza, in Ha-Kore et ha-Megillah, in Rav Sheshet's time. Who told him this prophecy, that he lived in Rav Sheshet's time? In that chapter, 21b, he visited Rav Ashi's house. But Rav Huna, Rav Sheshet's teacher, died before Rav Yehudah; Rava was born on the day Rav Yehudah died, and Rav Ashi was born on the day Rava died. One cannot say that he visited the earlier Rav Ashi, who lived in Rav's time, for even so he would not be in the generation of Rav Sheshet, Rav Huna's pupil, while Rav Huna was Rav's pupil.
